character.description: Armor-only connected front chest panels; canonical131 is sole identity/pose authority, not generated body output.

armor_front_idle.action: Exactly four separated connected armor-only chest panels corresponding in order to the four canonical131 idle poses. Same rigid compact breastplate; only its attached short flexible straps respond subtly to the matching torso. No body/head/arms/hands/legs/boots, no disconnected shoulder or bracer pieces. This row is an independent front component only, not an assembled hero.

style: Canonical131 grotesque dark-fairytale cartoon ink, matte broad painted values. Reference146 chest construction only, slightly cooler desaturated neutral-grey plate than the tan helmet; no green/teal materials.
